pcs.pc_description: Ensure the robot design meets the required precision and accuracy for the intended tasks.

perform all necessary tests and procedures required as per industry standards
override testing and motion types
create collision free path of the robot

modules.module_title: Adhere to standard safety procedures of the organisation

pcs.pc_description: comply with general safety procedures and those for handling equipment, tools, chemicals, and hazardous material, as prescribed and followed in the organisation
remove finger rings or any other metal objects likely to interfere with the work
ensure that identification badge or any other object worn around the neck or on the clothing does not get caught in any rotating machine, or otherwise interfere with the work
use appropriate safety devices such as goggles, gloves, ear plugs, caps, ESD pins, covers, shoes, helmets etc. recommended for the work being performed
inform, escalate, or raise alarm about any suspicions, unaccounted hazardous material, devices, or other objects found in the premises
inform, escalate, or raise alarm about any breach of safety or security procedure in the organisation
help achieve zero accidents goals at work
avoid damage to sensitive electronic components due to negligence of ESD procedures
participate regularly in fire drills or other safety related workshops organised by the organisation

follow strictly all access control and perimeter safety procedures in designated factory areas such as robotic work stations, automated production lines, automated material movement and other potentially risky operations
ensure that other people follow all access control and perimeter safety procedures in designated factory areas and help avoid accidents
use emergency switches or other mechanisms of stopping a machine immediately in case any emergency situation has developed or about to happen
ensure that electrical equipment are properly grounded
follow Cyber Security guidelines and be vigilant at workplace
proceed to designated safe assembly area immediately on hearing fire alarm
wash hands and use sanitizers as recommended to prevent spread of diseases
follow common personal hygiene practices
maintain appropriate posture, especially in long hours of sitting or standing position and in handling heavy materials
participate in company organised health sessions such as exercises, games, yoga, physiotherapy, and other activities
handle heavy and hazardous materials with care, while maintaining appropriate posture, using suitable tools, and handling equipment such as trolleys, jacks, and ladders
learn and apply first aid devices available in the workplace
learn and apply safety and handling procedures for electrical shock and electrocution
learn and apply emergency medical help services
follow workplace decorum and avoid emotional outbursts or inappropriate language
prevent any harassment at workplace
identify recyclable, non-recyclable, and hazardous waste generated in the workplace and comply with their disposal procedures
dispose non-recyclable waste and hazardous waste following recommended processes
deposit recyclable and reusable material at identified locations
support education and compliance of waste management processes
identify ways to optimize usage of material and resources such as water, electricity, energy in various tasks, activities, and processes
check for spills and leakages of material in various tasks, activities, and processes and plug them
escalate the leakage issue to appropriate authority if needed
carry out routine cleaning of tools, machines, and equipment and maintain them in good working condition to optimize efficiency and wastage
check if the equipment is functioning normally before commencing work and rectify or report any malfunctioning to the responsible agency

check for any odour, sparks, fumes, emission, unusual vibration, noise, or any other objectionable presence in the environment and take immediate corrective action followed by report to responsible agency
ensure electrical equipment are properly connected for use and are switched off when not in use
support education and compliance of resource conservation processes
